{{Top|leg}}
A '''breathing regulator''' was a device that could replace a being's lungs. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] lungs were severely scarred and burnt from [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar's]] [[Ko-shol gas]], one was used in place of lungs.<ref name="DV">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref>
